what: The arrow in a circle, when you hover the link or button containing it, slides out to the right, re-enters from the left and settles in place (.3s, cubic-bezier(.83,0,.17,1), once). The ‹nudge› type does not slip out but is pushed 15% and returns. The ‹squash› type flattens as it exits and unflattens as it enters. The ‹twin› type has two arrows at once: one leaves to the upper right and one enters from the lower left

options.--fx-dur: Length of one rotation (via style), default .3s
options.look: nudge: Small shape that gets pushed 15% and returns without dropping out (full travel by the 70% mark)
options.> :first-child: Moving arrow — first child (svg) of the circle element
options.--fx-shift: Exit and entry distance (via style), default 100% — use 250% to let the small arrow slip out past the circle
options.--fx-shift-in: Distance at which it starts re-entering from the left (via style), default same as --fx-shift — for originals where exit and entry distances differ (120%·160%)
options.look: fade: Fades out over the first 1/4, stays hidden for 1/4, then appears and enters over the latter half (original 25%·50% keyframes)
options.look: early: Type that exits in the first 36% and enters from the left over the remaining 64% (original 35.9%·36% keyframes)
options.look: half: Fades out in the first half, jumps left at 51%, then fades in and slides in during the second half (from the original’s 50% and 51% keyframes) · brand: --fx-shift 10px · --fx-dur .5s · --fx-ease ease
options.look: squash: Fades down to 40%, flattens to .1 vertically at 43% and exits to 105%, jumps to −145% at 44%, then unfolds from 50% and comes in (Brand original) — --fx-shift and --fx-shift-in default to 105% and 145%. When using, set --fx-dur: .5s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.12,1,.5,1)
options.--fx-rise: look: half — distance to travel up when leaving and from below when entering (via style), default 0 — a diagonal where it exits to the upper right and enters from the lower left (100%)
options.look: late: fades out until 79% and exits, at 80% jumps to the left and enters while appearing in the remaining 20% — a reference site’s airplane icon (.7s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1) · --fx-shift 150%)
options.look: twin: Two copies of the same arrow (first and second child) move at once — the first exits to the upper right and the second enters from the lower left. For this Type the defaults of --fx-shift·--fx-rise are 150%·150% (Brand preset: --fx-dur .4s · --fx-ease ease)
options.look: pause: Slides out until 45%, jumps to the left at 47%, stays off-screen left until 55%, then re-enters over the remaining 45% (Brand original arrow_run keyframes at 45%·46%·47%·48%·55%)
options.look: expo: Moves out fast with expo.inOut over the first .5/.7, jumps to the left at the end, and comes in with expo.out over the remaining .2/.7 — this type’s --fx-dur default is .7s, and the curve is baked into the keyframes so --fx-ease is not used (Brand: --fx-shift 30px).
options.look: inout: Accelerates out with power2.in over the first half, crosses over, then decelerates in with power2.out over the second half — the default --fx-dur for this type is .5s, and the curve is baked into the keyframes so --fx-ease is not used
options.look: mid: Exits through 61%, jumps to the left hidden at 61.1~61.3%, and enters in the remaining 39% (brand arrowSlideRight — --fx-dur .4s · --fx-ease cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1))
options.look: glide: Two copies slide into each other via transition. The first copy exits to (--fx-shift, −--fx-rise) and the second enters from (−--fx-shift-in, --fx-rise) into place (.3s ease by default, reverses on release and does not turn transparent). The content works at any depth inside a, button, label or li. Default distance 120%·120%, and for horizontal-only set --fx-rise: 0%
